newsitem.title: USA: Gables Residential revamps credit facility.
newsitem.headline: Gables Residential revamps credit facility.

text.p: Gables Residential Trust said Wednesday that it has restructured its credit facility, resulting in a reduced borrowing spread over LIBOR of 80 basis points, down from 110 basis points.
Also, the company now has a competitive bid option for a maximum of $87.5 million of its $175 million credit facility, it said in a statement.

In addition to the cost savings, Gables indicated this restructuring will increase its borrowing capacity under its credit facility by approximately $45.8 million and provide for a five-year credit enhancement term, versus the three-year term of its credit facility.
Gables also said it has completed the conversion of approximately $116 million of previously secured debt to an unsecured position, which has resulted in a higher interest rate by 20 basis points.

Gables said it has reached an agreement with Wachovia Bank, its credit facility agent, to provide a five year letter of credit facility to enhance approximately $45.8 million of tax-exempt bonds for an annual cost of 95 basis points.
These bonds are currently enhanced with letters of credit provided through the company's $175 million credit facility with an annual cost of 100 basis points.
Gables Residential, a real estate operating company, develops and owns apartment communities in Texas and the southeastern United States.
